verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own docs say Global Accounts receive bank transfers via local payment methods and/or SWIFT, from customers and platforms such as Amazon and Google. They also say accounts with local bank details can be created to collect in 60+ markets, with funds held in 20 currencies. This covers receiving payments in multiple currencies on local account details. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and an explicit per-currency list of which local account details Global Accounts issue (the 20-currency figure comes from the Banking-as-a-Service docs).
